question: What is the meaning of ease of re-assembly in relation to design for recycling?
description: Ease of re-assembly in relation to design for recycling refers to the consideration of making it simple and convenient to put materials or components back together after they have been disassembled. This aspect of design aims to facilitate the process of separating different parts during recycling and then easily reassembling them into new products or components.
